# UDF Çevirici (UDF Converter)

> A free, open source web tool that converts PDF and Word files into UDF, the
> document format used by UYAP, Türkiye's National Judiciary Informatics System,
> and UDF files back into PDF and Word. The conversion runs entirely in the visitor's browser: no
> file is uploaded to any server, and the page works offline once loaded.

Each PDF page is rendered in the browser at 200 DPI and embedded into the UDF
document as a full-page image, so the output looks identical to the source PDF.
The result opens in the UYAP Doküman Editörü and can be filed through UYAP.

- Price: free, no account, no installation, no usage limit.
- Privacy: files never leave the visitor's device; nothing is sent to a server.
- Input: PDF only, one file at a time. Password-protected PDFs must be unlocked first.
- Output: a .udf file whose text is not editable, because pages are embedded as images.
- Word documents: use the Word to UDF page below for editable text, or export to PDF first to keep the exact look as page images.
- Very large PDFs (hundreds of pages) can exhaust browser memory; split them first.
- Not affiliated with UYAP or e-Devlet.

The site also converts the other way. The UDF to PDF page reads a .udf file in
the browser (the ZIP's content.xml: text pool, paragraphs, runs, tabs, tables,
images, header, footer, page numbers, letterhead background, page format) and
lays it out as a PDF with real, selectable text using pdfmake and the open
licensed Tinos, Arimo and Cousine fonts, which share the metrics of Times New
Roman, Arial and Courier New. The pages are shown on the page before download;
the UDF viewer page uses the same code to open and read a .udf file without
installing UYAP Doküman Editörü. An e-signature is not carried into the PDF and
the PDF is not an official copy, so the original UDF should be kept for UYAP.

Two more pages convert between Word and UDF in the browser. Word to UDF reads a
.docx file (styles, numbering, theme fonts, tables, images, header, footer, page
setup) and writes a UDF with real, editable text in the structure the UYAP
Doküman Editörü saves: one CDATA text pool, elements pointing into it by offset,
and the editor's own attribute names. Legacy binary .doc files are not read; they
must be saved as .docx in Word first. UDF to Word turns a .udf file into an
editable .docx with paragraphs, run formatting, tab stops, lists, tables, images,
page setup, header, footer and page numbers. Neither direction carries an
e-signature.

The PDF to UDF conversion is published on npm as `uyap-udf` (`npm install uyap-udf`,
then `convertPdfBufferToUdf`), requiring no system dependencies since PDF
rendering uses PDFium via WebAssembly. `convertPdfBufferToUdf` returns
`{ ok: true, udf }` or `{ ok: false, error }` instead of throwing.

## Docs

- [PDF UDF Çevirme](https://projects.halit.org/uyap-pdf/): the converter in Turkish, with steps, privacy notes and FAQ
- [PDF to UDF Converter](https://projects.halit.org/uyap-pdf/en/): the same page in English
- [UDF PDF Çevirme](https://projects.halit.org/uyap-pdf/udf-pdf-cevirme/): UDF to PDF converter in Turkish, with what the PDF keeps, limitations and FAQ
- [UDF to PDF Converter](https://projects.halit.org/uyap-pdf/en/udf-to-pdf/): the same converter in English
- [UDF Görüntüleyici](https://projects.halit.org/uyap-pdf/udf-goruntuleyici/): Turkish page to open and read a .udf file in the browser, with an optional PDF download
- [UDF Dosyası Nedir, Nasıl Açılır?](https://projects.halit.org/uyap-pdf/udf-dosyasi-nedir-nasil-acilir/): Turkish guide to the UDF format (a ZIP holding content.xml), where to download UYAP Doküman Editörü officially, and how to read a UDF without it
- [Word UDF Çevirme](https://projects.halit.org/uyap-pdf/word-udf-cevirme/): Word (.docx) to UDF converter in Turkish, with what the UDF keeps, limitations, other routes and FAQ
- [Word to UDF Converter](https://projects.halit.org/uyap-pdf/en/word-to-udf/): the same converter in English
- [UDF Word Çevirme](https://projects.halit.org/uyap-pdf/udf-word-cevirme/): UDF to Word (.docx) converter in Turkish, with what the Word file keeps, limitations and FAQ
- [UDF to Word Converter](https://projects.halit.org/uyap-pdf/en/udf-to-word/): the same converter in English
- [Library README](https://github.com/halitsever/uyap-pdf/blob/main/Readme.md): install and API of the `uyap-udf` Node library

## Optional

- [Source](https://github.com/halitsever/uyap-pdf): repository
- [npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/uyap-udf): package page
